tools.name: identify_farmer
tools.description: Identify a returning caller by their four-digit PIN. Returns status found (with the caller's profile, prices and history), not_found (with attempts_left) or locked.

pin.description: The caller's four-digit PIN, digits only, from the keypad or spoken.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description: Get the 7-day rain and temperature forecast for the caller's district. Returns status ok, unknown_location or unavailable.

district.description: The district to forecast, if the caller names one; otherwise leave empty to use their own.
